display_name: CDC NSSP County-Level ED Visit Proportions (Trends)
description: County-level emergency department visit percentages and trajectory (trend) direction from the National Syndromic Surveillance Program, wide-format dataset. Supplements Delphi metro signals and enables county-level context.

wide_format_fields._comment: rdmq-nq56 is wide-format: one row per county per week, with per-pathogen columns. Map disease_key -> raw %, smoothed %, and trend column. CDC quirk: the smoothed influenza column is 'percent_visits_smoothed_1' (not '_influenza').

trend_mapping._comment: Maps rdmq-nq56 ed_trends_* string values to the internal trend vocabulary used by leader_detection (rising/declining/stable/unknown).

s3_storage._comment: Per-county-per-disease layout mirrors the Delphi per-county pattern so downstream code can look up a single county's latest signal cheaply.

notes.granularity: County-level (FIPS). geography field carries the state name; national rows use geography='United States'.
notes.relationship_to_delphi: Same underlying NSSP program. Used SUPPLEMENTALLY: gap-fills Delphi trend when Delphi has too few points, corroborates rising signals, and provides each subscribing county's own measured ED-visit % + trend as alert context. Never suppresses a Delphi-driven detection.
notes.dataset_note: rdmq-nq56 is the wide-format 'NSSP ED Visit Trajectories' table (percent_visits_{pathogen}, percent_visits_smoothed_*, ed_trends_{pathogen}, fips, county, geography, week_end, hsa). Distinct from vutn-jzwm (state-level, long-format) which cdc_nssp.json uses for state context.
